elements.requirement: Loss relief under Chapter 6 of Part 4 of ITA 2007 or Chapter 5 of Part 4 of CTA 2010 is defined as "share loss relief".
elements.quote: Chapter 6 of Part 4 of ITA 2007 or Chapter 5 of Part 4 of CTA 2010 (“share loss relief”)

elements.requirement: Where share loss relief is obtained in respect of a loss or any part of a loss, no deduction may be made under the Taxation of Chargeable Gains Act 1992 in respect of that loss or that part of the loss.
elements.quote: no deduction is to be made in respect of the loss or (as the case may be) the part under this Act

elements.requirement: Where a claim is made for share loss relief in respect of a loss accruing on the disposal of shares, section 30 applies to the disposal as if references in subsections (1)(b) and (5) to a tax-free benefit were replaced with references to any benefit whether tax-free or not.
elements.quote: section 30 has effect in relation to the disposal as if for the references in subsections (1)(b) and (5) to a tax-free benefit there were substituted references to any benefit whether tax-free or not

elements.requirement: All adjustments of corporation tax on chargeable gains or capital gains tax, whether by way of assessment, discharge, or repayment of tax, must be made as required in consequence of share loss relief being obtained in respect of an allowable loss.
elements.quote: All such adjustments of corporation tax on chargeable gains or capital gains tax are to be made, whether by way of assessment or by way of discharge or repayment of tax, as may be required in consequence of— (a) share loss relief being obtained in respect of an allowable loss

elements.requirement: All adjustments of corporation tax on chargeable gains or capital gains tax, whether by way of assessment, discharge, or repayment of tax, must be made as required in consequence of share loss relief not being obtained in respect of the whole or part of an allowable loss for which a claim is made.
elements.quote: All such adjustments of corporation tax on chargeable gains or capital gains tax are to be made, whether by way of assessment or by way of discharge or repayment of tax, as may be required in consequence of— (a) share loss relief being obtained in respect of an allowable loss, or (b) such relief not being obtained in respect of the whole or part of such a loss in respect of which a claim is made
